paper.title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
paper.ai_summary: Prospective learning via Self-Retrospection Distillation uses hindsight experience to train foresight predictions, improving reinforcement learning when outcome rewards are uniform.

paper.title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents
paper.ai_summary: MIMESIS is a specialized user simulator trained on human interactions that improves agent training via multi-turn reinforcement learning and self-distillation coaching, yielding stronger generalization across diverse simulated users.
paper.summary: Training and evaluating interactive language agents typically requires rich user interactions, yet collecting human feedback is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulated users offer a scalable alternative, but they must both resemble real user behavior and provide useful learning experiences for agents.
